title: 第316章 大白不怕因果吗第315章 这可是登仙梯啊
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：749局：我一个邪修考编怎么了第一卷：默认第316章大白不怕因果吗？（..la）“出去？凭什么让我们出去啊！”
一听大白要赶人，林小蛮当即就不乐意了。
她瞪圆了眼睛，一脸抗拒。
她可是堂堂剑阁阁主的亲传弟子，什么神兵利器没见过？
但唯独这用登仙梯碎片打造的道器，她是真的一次都没开过眼！
现在大宝贝马上就要拿出来了，怎么可能甘心被赶出去？
“就是啊！”
林小蛮双手叉腰，理直气壮地反驳，“有什么见不得光的？大家都是自己人，我们在旁边看一眼怎么了？看一眼那六欲伞还能掉块肉不成？”
萧逸也回过神来，赶紧附和：“对对对！大白，你这就不够意思了吧！你一个化神境的大妖，还怕我们几个元婴境抢了道器啊？！我们保证就站在这里，退后三米，绝对不伸手摸，就让我们开开眼界呗！”
看着这俩不要命也要看热闹的家伙，一直瘫在沙发上的陈邪突然叹了口气。
陈邪没有说话，而是直接从沙发上站起身，双手插在裤兜里，晃晃悠悠地越过萧逸和林小蛮，朝着办公室的大门走去。
这一下，悟德愣住了。
“老陈，你干什么去？”
悟德摸着大光头，一脸不解。
“出去啊，还能干嘛？”
陈邪头都没回。
林小蛮急了，赶紧伸手去拉陈邪的衣角：“哎呀！陈邪！那六欲伞可是你的法宝啊！你才是正主！连你都要出去干嘛呀？你就不好奇这道器拿出来的场面吗？”
陈邪停下脚步，转过头，嫌弃地瞥了林小蛮和萧逸一眼，翻了个白眼。
“我刚才说的话，你们是当耳旁风了吗？”
陈邪没好气地骂了一句，“小爷我刚才不是说得很清楚了嘛！那六欲伞因为是用登仙梯碎片打造的，牵扯的因果太特么大了！”

陈邪指了指裴青云，又指了指大白，声音严厉了几分：“小爷我现在若是还不出去，难道还要等大白把六欲伞掏出来，让那庞大因果直接锁定在小爷身上，然后让小爷遭天谴不得好死啊？！”
陈邪冷笑一声：“你们要是想沾染这因果，你们就在这待着。反正小爷还没活够，恕不奉陪！”
说完，陈邪毫不犹豫地拉开门，大步走了出去。
“福生无量天尊！”
张怀道二话不说，一秒钟的犹豫都没有，直接起身，几步就窜到了陈邪身后，跟着他溜了出去。
虽然他心里也对那传说中的道器好奇得不行。
但是，在西开分局七处混了这么久，他早就用血泪换来一个教训。
在这个土匪窝里，不管发生什么邪门的事，只要紧紧跟着陈邪的步伐走，那就准没错！
保命永远排在看热闹的第一位！
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Bureau 749: What happened to me, an evil cultivator? Volume 1: Default Chapter 316: Isn’t Dabai afraid of cause and effect? (..la) "Get out? Why are you letting us out!"
As soon as Lin Xiaoman heard that Dabai was going to drive people away, he immediately became unhappy.
Her eyes widened and she resisted.
She is the direct disciple of the dignified Sword Pavilion Master. What magical weapon has she not seen?
But only for this Taoist tool made from the fragments of the Immortal Ladder, she really never opened her eyes once!
Now that the big baby is about to be taken out, how can he be willing to be kicked out?
"That's right!"
Lin Xiaoman put his hands on his hips and retorted confidently, "What's so shameful? We are all our own people, what's wrong with us just taking a look at it? Can we lose a piece of meat just by taking a look at the Six Desire Umbrella?"
Xiao Yi also came back to his senses and quickly echoed: "Yes, yes! Dabai, you are not interesting enough! You are a great demon in the spirit transformation realm, and you are afraid that a few of us in the Yuanying realm will steal the Taoist artifact?! We promise to stand here, step back three meters, and never reach out to touch, just let us open our eyes!"
Looking at these two guys who wanted to watch the excitement even if they risked their lives, Chen Xie, who had been slumped on the sofa, suddenly sighed.
Chen Xie did not speak, but stood up from the sofa, put his hands in his trouser pockets, walked unsteadily past Xiao Yi and Lin Xiaoman, and walked towards the door of the office.
At this moment, Wude was stunned.
"Old Chen, what are you doing?"
Wude touched his bald head, looking puzzled.
"Go out, what else can you do?"
Chen Xie didn't even look back.
Lin Xiaoman was anxious and quickly reached out to pull Chen Xie's clothes: "Oh! Chen Xie! That Six Desire Umbrella is your magic weapon! You are the real master! Why do you even have to go out? Aren't you curious about the scene when this Taoist weapon is taken out?"
Chen Xie stopped, turned his head, glanced at Lin Xiaoman and Xiao Yi with disgust, and rolled his eyes.
"Did you turn a deaf ear to what I just said?"
Chen Xie cursed angrily, "Master, didn't I make it very clear just now? Because the Six Desire Umbrella was made from fragments of the Immortal Ladder, the cause and effect involved are too huge!"
Chen Xie pointed at Pei Qingyun, then at Dabai, and his voice was a bit stern: "Master, if I don't go out now, am I going to have to wait for Dabai to take out the Six Desire Umbrella, let the huge cause and effect be directly locked on the master, and then let the master be punished by God and die a happy death?!"
Chen Xie sneered: "If you want to be tainted by this karma, just stay here. Anyway, I haven't lived enough yet, so I won't accompany you!"
After saying that, Chen Xie opened the door without hesitation and strode out.
"Blessings and Immeasurable Heavenly Lord!"
Zhang Huaidao didn't say anything, didn't hesitate for a second, stood up directly, ran behind Chen Xie in a few steps, and slipped out after him.
Although he was extremely curious about the legendary Taoist weapon.
However, after spending so long in Section 7 of Xikai Branch, he had already learned a lesson with his blood and tears.
In this bandit's den, no matter what evil things happen, as long as you follow Chen Xie's steps closely, you will be right!
Saving your life is always the first priority!
